masteryZone.q: The Preamble to the Indian Constitution is based on which resolution?
masteryZone.sol: The Preamble is based on Nehru's Objective Resolution.

masteryZone.q: On which date was the Constitution and its Preamble adopted?
masteryZone.sol: Adopted on November 26, 1949 (celebrated as Constitution Day).

masteryZone.q: True or False: The Preamble is justiciable and enforceable in a court of law.
masteryZone.sol: False. The Preamble is non-justiciable and cannot be enforced in a court of law.

masteryZone.q: Who calligraphed the cursive text of the original Constitution?
What type of socialism does India practice according to the Supreme Court?
masteryZone.sol: Indian socialism is Democratic Socialism, representing a mixed economy model.

masteryZone.q: The term 'Republic' implies which of the following?
masteryZone.sol: A Republic has an elected Head of State (President) rather than a hereditary monarch.

masteryZone.q: True or False: The positive concept of secularism means the state gives equal respect and status to all religions.
masteryZone.sol: True. positive secularism means all religions receive equal treatment and status from the state.

masteryZone.q: Which of the following is the correct order of the words in the Preamble?
masteryZone.sol: The order is Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Republic.

masteryZone.q: In which case did the Supreme Court hold that the Preamble is NOT a part of the Constitution?
masteryZone.sol: Berubari Union Case (1960) ruled that the Preamble is not a part of the Constitution.

masteryZone.q: In which case did the Supreme Court state that the Preamble forms part of the Basic Structure?
masteryZone.sol: Kesavananda Bharati Case (1973) held it to be a part of basic structure.

masteryZone.q: True or False: The Preamble is a source of power to the Parliament.
masteryZone.sol: False. It is neither a source of power nor a prohibition on legislative powers.

masteryZone.q: True or False: The Preamble was adopted by the Assembly after the rest of the Constitution was already adopted.
masteryZone.sol: True. The Preamble was adopted last to ensure agreement with the rest of the Constitution.

masteryZone.q: How many times has the Preamble been amended so far?
masteryZone.sol: It has been amended only once, by the 42nd Amendment in 1976.

masteryZone.q: Which of the following words was NOT added by the 42nd Amendment?
masteryZone.sol: Democratic was already present; Socialist, Secular, and Integrity were added.

masteryZone.q: The Preamble can be amended under which Article of the Constitution?
masteryZone.sol: It can be amended under Article 368, subject to basic structure limitations.

masteryZone.q: True or False: The amendment adding 'Secular' to the Preamble was held constitutionally invalid.
masteryZone.sol: False. The Supreme Court upheld the amendment as fully valid.
